limits: Dynamic lookups include local array indexing, not exclusively external assets; their keys are shown rather than guessed.

flow_semantics: Structural source order and nested arms, not a linear execution trace. Expressions retain Python short-circuit/eager semantics; long literal containers are abbreviated with original source anchors.
